title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2026.2.19562 project admins of a related project could delete VCS integrations owned by…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack versions before 2026.2.19562 allows project administrators of one project to delete version control system (VCS) integrations owned by another related project. This issue arises from improper access control between related projects.
